items.name: Patong & Kalim
items.tagline: Party town, with real techno in Shelter at Illuzion
items.description: Phuket's busiest and loudest area. Bangla Road closes to cars from 18:00 and fills with bars, go-go bars and big clubs. Illuzion is number 9 in DJ Mag's Top 100 Clubs 2026; its Shelter room plays techno and minimal. Hotels for every budget and street food. Kalim, just north, is a quieter rocky bay with good restaurants.
items.beach: In January the 3 km bay is calm and fine for swimming; the north end is quieter with clearer water, the centre has jet skis, and rocky Kalim is not a swimming beach.
highlights: Shelter, the 500-capacity techno room at Illuzion (most Fridays and Saturdays, from about 23:30)
Bangla Road walking street from 18:00
O Beach Ibiza pool party at Barra Cuda Beach Club (8, 13 and 15 Jan)
Longtail boat to Freedom Beach from the pontoon at the south end (high season)
Sunset dinner above Kalim at L'Arôme by the Sea
items.stayIf: Stay here if you want to walk to Shelter and Illuzion and do not mind noise; sleep at the north end or in Kalim.
tips: Change money at Lion Currency Exchange in Jungceylon (09:00-21:00). The Value Plus booth on Soi Sansabai is open until 04:00.
Illuzion and Shelter: bring your passport (20+), no flip-flops or beachwear.
Skip the go-go show touts with menus; they often charge extra.

links.label: O Beach Ibiza x Barra Cuda tickets

items.verification: Shelter page (250 m2, 500 capacity, techno/house/minimal) and the Illuzion events feed: 17 Shelter nights Jul-Oct 2026, all Fri/Sat except one Thu, mostly 23:30. DJ Mag 2026 rank 9 from the djmag.com listing (search snippet; page blocks bots). O Beach dates on Megatix. Phuket101 Patong (4 Oct 2026), Kalim (12 Mar 2026) and Illuzion (29 Aug 2026: 20+, passport, no flip-flops). Lion hours from Google, Value Plus Sansabai 09:00-04:00 from the Value Plus branch API. Pin: Google 'Patong Beach' 13 m, Wikidata 50 m, on the OSM beach. Old gmapsQuery opened the Pa Tong subdistrict, not the beach.

items.name: Kamala
items.tagline: Calm family beach with Café del Mar at the north end
items.description: A long, wide beach by a Muslim fishing village, calmer and more Thai than Patong. Families, couples and repeat visitors like it. Café del Mar at the quiet north end books big house and techno DJs in season. Apart from Café del Mar, nights are quiet; Phuket FantaSea and Carnival Magic are the big evening shows.
items.beach: About 2 km of soft sand with tree shade. In January the sea is usually calm and clear, one of the easiest swims on the island.
highlights: Argy on the Café del Mar Pyramid Stage, Fri 8 Jan from 14:00 (presale sign-up opens 20 Oct, 18:00)
Marco Carola, with Nicolas Masseyeff, at Café del Mar, Wed 13 Jan from 14:00
Café del Mar Club Room DJ nights, Wed-Sat from 22:00
Sunset drinks at Pine Beach Bar (InterContinental) at the north end
Phuket FantaSea show: Tue, Fri and Sun, show at 21:00
items.stayIf: Stay here if you want a calm beach, Café del Mar on foot, and Shelter, Niky's and Enthusiast Place within about 20 minutes by car.
tips: Sign up or buy tickets early on phuket.cafedelmar.com. Loungers and beds work on a minimum spend.
Carnival Magic, next to FantaSea, runs on Mon, Wed and Sat evenings.
Kamala and Patong are linked by one hill road; after a party use Grab or Bolt.
items.verification: Café del Mar events page (15 Oct 2026): the 8 Jan Pyramid Stage night is now Argy (presale 20 Oct 18:00), so it is no longer secret; Marco Carola 13 Jan 14:00 on the venue site and RA (with Nicolas Masseyeff); Club Room 'Wed-Sat 10pm-late'. Phuket101 Café del Mar (29 Aug 2026): north end, minimum spend for beds. FantaSea days from its official site and Google (Tue/Fri/Sun); Carnival Magic Mon/Wed/Sat from Google and Phuket101 Kamala (5 Oct 2026). Pine Beach Bar on Google at the north end. Pin: OSM beach mid-section; Google 70 m, Wikidata 65 m.

items.name: Surin & Pansea
items.tagline: One of Phuket's best beaches, now with nothing on the sand
items.description: An 800 m bay of soft pale sand between Kamala and Bang Tao, with casuarina trees behind it. All food stalls, sunbeds and massages were removed in May 2025, so it looks natural again. Tukta, on the rocks at the south end, is one of only two places still serving food. Twinpalms, The Surin and Amanpuri are close.
items.beach: In January the water is clear and calm, some of the best swimming in Phuket. There are no sunbeds or umbrellas, so bring water and sit in the tree shade.
highlights: Morning swim in clear, calm water
Lunch with a view at Tukta, on the rocks at the south end
Laem Singh Beach: a 15-20 minute walk over the rocks, or a 100 THB boat
Sunset under the casuarina trees
items.stayIf: Stay here if you want a quiet luxury hotel on a beautiful beach and will take taxis for food and parties.
tips: Come in the morning and bring water; there are no sunbeds or shops on the sand.
Laem Singh has had no road access since April 2017. Walk over the boulders from the south end of Surin (not at high tide) or take a boat, about 100 THB one way.
Pansea Beach, just north, is only for guests of The Surin and Amanpuri.
items.verification: Phuket101 Surin (16 Sep 2026): vendors removed since May 2025, Tukta is 'one of the two restaurants still operating', Pansea is guests-only. Phuket101 Laem Singh (4 Aug 2026): road cut April 2017, 15-20 min walk, boat 100 THB. Tukta Food & Drink, The Surin, Twinpalms and Amanpuri all active on Google. Catch Beach Club is on Bang Tao, so it was dropped from Surin highlights. Pin: Google 37 m, Wikidata 15 m, OSM beach midpoint. Note: the only photo is from 2008, before the clear-outs.

items.name: Bang Tao, Laguna & Cherngtalay
items.tagline: Long beach, top restaurants, beach clubs and Niky's
items.description: A 6 km beach with the Laguna resort complex in the middle and Cherngtalay town behind it. The upmarket side of Phuket: villas, Michelin-listed restaurants and Boat Avenue's shops and bars. Catch and Xana beach clubs have DJs, and Niky's Speakeasy & Nightclub plays house and techno until 02:00. Traffic is often bad.
items.beach: In January the sea is mostly calm, but the water gets deep faster than at many beaches. The beach is never crowded. In mid-2026 the authorities shut the beach bars on the south stretch, between SAii Laguna and Arinara.
highlights: Catch Beach Club: DJ daybeds, Friday BBQ (19:00-22:00) and Sunday brunch (12:00-15:00)
Niky's Speakeasy & Nightclub: house and techno, Tue-Sun 20:00-02:00
Fun Friday Avenue night market at Boat Avenue (Fri 16:00-21:00)
Enthusiast Place: free Open Doors music session every Tuesday from 19:00, about 15 minutes inland
items.coordSource: osm-beach(way 150298518) midpoint+wikidata(Q16306319, 47 m); Google pin 660 m south on the same beach
items.stayIf: Stay here if you want great food and beach clubs, Niky's nearby and a 30-minute ride to the airport, and do not need a party street.
tips: Niky's website was offline in Oct 2026; check its Google Maps listing for the night's programme.
Value Plus has an exchange booth on Lagoon Road near Boat Avenue (09:00-20:00).
Leave extra time for traffic around Cherngtalay, especially in the evening.
items.verification: Phuket101 Bang Tao (5 Oct 2026): 6 km, calm in high season, 'not as shallow', never crowded, bars between SAii Laguna and Arinara shut in 2026 (16 venues named in a June 2026 investigation; a Thairath report of 26 June 2026 says 16 shops were ordered shut). Catch site: DJ daybeds, Fri BBQ 19-22, Sun brunch 12-15, on Bang Tao. Niky's: Google listing active, Tue-Sun 20:00-02:00, owner text says techno and house; one Tripadvisor review (May 2025) says 'house & techno'; nikys-speakeasy.com did not connect (15 Oct 2026). Enthusiast Place site: Open Doors every Tuesday 19:00, free. Boat Avenue market Fri 16-21 (Phuket101 + Google). Value Plus Laguna 09:00-20:00 from its API; its Phuket rates are not published, so the rate comment was removed. Pin: OSM midpoint, Wikidata 47 m.

items.name: Layan
items.tagline: Quiet north end of Bang Tao with an island and a river
items.description: The quiet north end of Bang Tao Bay, inside Sirinat National Park. The beach ends at a river mouth with a big wooded island in front. The small restaurants under the trees were removed; only Tan Restaurant & Massage is left. Anantara Layan and other luxury villas sit just north of the river. Very quiet at night.
items.beach: In January the sea is usually calm and good for a swim. Massages are still offered, but there is almost no food or drink on the sand, so bring water.
highlights: The wooded island and river mouth at the north end of the beach
Sunset drinks at Beach House Layan (Anantara), which has a rooftop bar
Walk south along the sand onto Bang Tao Beach
Daft Funk Live (Daft Punk tribute band) at Banana Beach Club, Thu 14 Jan from 17:00, 10 minutes north by car (fun, not underground)
items.coordSource: google(Layan Beach, 171 m)+osm(Layan beach Restaurant node, 78 m)+google(Sirinat NP unit Hat Layan, 67 m)+commons photo GPS (121 m)+esri imagery
items.stayIf: Stay here if you want a peaceful villa or resort near the airport and Bang Tao, and will take taxis for nights out.
tips: For the public beach, follow the signs to Banyan Tree from Bang Tao and drive to the very end of the road; it is narrow in places.
Anantara Layan and Beach House face a small cove north of the river mouth; the long public beach is south of it.
Bang Tao's restaurants and Niky's are 10-15 minutes away by car.
items.verification: Re-pinned 849 m. The old pin was the OSM 'Layan Beach' way, which is the small Anantara cove north of the river mouth. Google's 'Layan Beach', the Sirinat park unit 'Hat Layan', Tan Restaurant & Massage (Phuket101, 26 Aug 2026: the last restaurant on Layan Beach), the OSM 'Layan beach Restaurant' and the GPS of the Commons 'Layan beach' photo all sit on the public beach south of the river; imagery confirms sand at the new point. So the old tip that Google's pin was wrong was itself wrong. Inside Sirinat NP per the OSM park boundary. Daft Funk on Megatix: Thu 14 Jan 17:00, Banana Beach Club by Sollis 2.0 (OSRM 6 min from the beach). Beach House Layan (Rooftop, Dee Plee, Breeze) on its site, open 12-22 on Google.

items.name: Nai Thon
items.tagline: Quiet bay under green hills, 15 minutes from the airport
items.description: A small curved bay below steep hills, inside Sirinat National Park. There is no real town, just a few hotels, guesthouses and simple Thai restaurants along the beach. Quiet day and night. Banana Beach, 2 km south, changed in late 2025: the old jungle path closed, and a car park (100 THB) and a big beach club opened.
items.beach: In January the sea is calm and the bay is good for swimming, with fine sand and few people.
highlights: Swim in a calm, uncrowded bay
Banana Beach and Banana Beach Club, 2 km south (parking 100 THB)
Simple Thai meals at the small restaurants by the beach
Short ride to Nai Yang and the plane-spotting beach
items.coordSource: osm-beach(way 53166566) midpoint+photon(12 m); Google pin and a Commons photo GPS 300 m north on the same beach
items.stayIf: Stay here if you want a quiet beach close to the airport for your first or last nights.

links.label: Wikivoyage: Nai Thon and Nai Yang

items.verification: Phuket101 Banana Beach (13 Aug 2026): old hilltop path closed late 2025, new car park 100 THB, new beach club; Google and Megatix name it Banana Beach Club by Sollis 2.0 (4.7, 863 reviews, 1.7 km from this pin). Phuket101 Sirinat page and the OSM park boundary put Nai Thon inside the park. Sources disagree on whether the restaurants are on the sand (Wikivoyage) or across the road (Lonely Planet, checked), so the text now says 'along the beach'. Patong time kept at 40 min (OSRM 34 min without traffic). Pin: OSM beach midpoint; Google 300 m north on the same beach.

items.name: Nai Yang
items.tagline: Beach restaurants and planes, 10 minutes from the airport
items.description: A relaxed beach village next to the airport, inside Sirinat National Park. Casuarina trees give shade, and simple restaurants put tables on the sand. It has an old-Phuket feel. There is a coral reef off the beach, and the plane-spotting spot at the end of the runway is close. Nightlife is a few small bars.
items.beach: In January the sea is calm, but the water is very shallow and less blue than further south; it is nicer at the north end of the bay.
highlights: Dinner at a restaurant on the sand
Planes landing low over the south end of Mai Khao Beach
Snorkel off the beach near the park lifeguard post (dry season)
Shade and picnics in Sirinat National Park
items.coordSource: osm-beach(way 1020477061)+google(Naiyang Beach, 45 m)+commons photo GPS (14 m)
items.stayIf: Stay here if you have an early flight or want simple beach food and a local feel near the airport.
tips: Money Shop Exchange has an office in Nai Yang, open about 10:00-19:00 (OK rates, lower than the best changers).
items.verification: Phuket101 Nai Yang (30 Sep 2026): casuarina shade, beach restaurants (The Good View, Sea Almond), very shallow water, nicer in the north, minimal nightlife, standing in the landing path is forbidden. Reef and snorkelling from the lifeguard post from Wikivoyage; other guides also describe a reef close to shore, partly bleached. Money Shop Nai Yang active on Google (4.8), 10:00-19:00. Pin: OSM beach, Google 'Naiyang Beach' 45 m. The old gmapsQuery returned two pins, one of them 2.3 km north by the runway; 'Naiyang Beach, Thalang, Phuket' returns only the right one.

items.name: Mai Khao
items.tagline: 11 km of empty sand, big resorts and landing planes
items.description: Phuket's longest beach, 11 km, inside Sirinat National Park. No chairs, vendors or jet skis, just a few big resorts set back from the sand, such as Sala, Renaissance, JW Marriott and Anantara. Sea turtles sometimes nest here from November to February. Patong is an hour away, and there is nothing to walk to at night.
items.beach: January is the calmest month here, but there are no shops or chairs on the sand, so bring water and sun cream for long walks.
highlights: Plane spotting at the south end of the beach
Long, empty beach walks at sunset
Turtle nesting season, November to February (nests are rare)
Splash Jungle Waterpark (daily 10:00-18:30)
items.coordSource: osm-beach(relation 16031134) midpoint+wikidata(Q14223640, 108 m); Google pin 1.3 km south on the same beach
items.stayIf: Stay here if you want a big resort on an empty beach close to the airport and do not plan many nights out.
tips: Standing in the planes' landing path is officially forbidden; watch from the side, not on the runway line.

imageCandidates.source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:หาดทรายขาว_น้ำใส_คลื่นสวย.jpg

items.verification: Phuket101 Mai Khao (26 Sep 2026): 11 km, no chairs/vendors except near the runway, no jet skis, Sala/Renaissance/JW Marriott, nesting Nov-Feb; Wikivoyage: calmest sea around January. All four resorts active on Google. Splash Jungle site: 'open daily (until further notice) 10:00-18:30'. Landing-path rule from Phuket101 (signs in the park). Pin: OSM midpoint, Wikidata 108 m, so confidence raised to high.

items.name: Karon
items.tagline: Big, open beach with a relaxed small town
items.description: A wide 3 km beach with a road and promenade behind it, so it never feels crowded. Most hotels are across the road, and the small town has beer bars, live music and good-value restaurants. Families and repeat visitors like it. The dry sand squeaks under your feet. Patong is about 15 minutes north and Kata is next door.
items.beach: In January the sea is usually calm and good for swimming; the strong rip currents here are a May-October problem, but still check the flags.
highlights: Karon Temple Market (Tue and Fri, 16:00-22:00)
Sunset fire show at Tann Beach Club (19:00)
Sunset drinks at COAST Beach Club, Centara Grand
Dinner along the beachfront promenade
items.stayIf: Stay here if you want a big, calm beach and good value, with Patong's clubs about 15 minutes away.
tips: The quietest sand is at the north end, near the lake.
Money Shop Exchange has offices in Karon and Kata (OK rates).

imageCandidates.credit: กสิณธร ราชโอรส

items.verification: Phuket101 Karon (5 Oct 2026): 3.3 km, promenade, squeaky sand, quieter north end by the lake, swim Dec-May and serious rips May-Oct, Tann fire show 19:00 nightly, COAST at Centara Grand. Temple Market Tue and Fri 16:00-22:00 (Phuket101, 14 Mar 2026). Tann Beach Club (4.5) and Coast Beach Club & Bistro (4.4) active on Google; Money Shop Karon and Kata on Google. Pin: Google 26 m, Wikidata 170 m, OSM beach midpoint.

items.name: Kata (Kata Yai)
items.tagline: Beautiful bay with an island; busy, easy and walkable
items.description: One of Phuket's most beautiful beaches, with soft sand, blue water and Koh Pu, a small island in the bay. It is busy, but nightlife is calm: beer bars, a night market and sunset bars. Club Med fills about 90% of the beachfront, so you reach the sand from the two ends. Many restaurants and hotels, from budget to luxury.
items.beach: In January the sea is calm, clear and good for swimming (the surf and red-flag season is about June to November); the north end is the quietest part.
highlights: Sunset with Koh Pu island in front of the beach
Ska Bar under its big tree at the south end
Kata Night Market (daily, 14:00-23:00)
Karon Viewpoint over three bays, about 3 km south
items.stayIf: Stay here if the beach matters most and you want an easy, walkable area with many restaurants.
tips: Shops and restaurants are on the second road; the beach road is quiet because Club Med fills the beachfront.
items.verification: Phuket101 Kata (5 Oct 2026): Koh Pu, Club Med on 90% of the beachfront with access from the two ends, surf and unsafe swimming June-November, quieter north end, beer bars, Kata Night Market 14:00-23:00 daily, Ska Bar, Karon Viewpoint about 3 km. Ska Bar (10:00-01:00), the night market, Club Med and Karon Viewpoint active on Google. The 'busiest after Patong' claim had no source and was removed. Pin: OSM midpoint, Wikidata 97 m, Google 136 m.
